drop_scan: Drop folder or click to scan
drag_hint: Drag a folder here to start indexing
shortcut_description: Press this keyboard shortcut to open the Spotlight Search overlay from anywhere in your operating system.
shortcut_record_title: Click to record a new shortcut
privacy_local_description: Core indexing, OCR, and search stay local on your machine. Optional cloud intelligence below can send file names, metadata, and short snippets to OpenRouter for smarter workspace summaries.
privacy_ocr_candidates_description: {count} indexed files look scanned or image-based and may need OCR for full-text search.
privacy_export_description: Download a transparent JSON backup of everything currently cached in your local index.
diagnostics_description: Inspect recent local events, watch state, and export a support bundle for debugging.
diagnostics_export_unavailable: Diagnostic export is only available in the desktop app.
watched_folders_description: Scanned folders stay watched for new files while the app is running.
watched_folders_empty: No watched folders yet. Scan a folder to keep it watched for new files.
privacy_cloud_intelligence_description: Let OpenRouter generate smarter workspace summaries from file names, metadata, and short snippets. Existing cached summaries stay local.
privacy_cloud_intelligence_enabled_hint: New AI summaries can be generated when workspace evidence changes or when you refresh a card.
privacy_cloud_intelligence_disabled_hint: No new cloud summary requests will be sent. Cached summaries stay available locally.
privacy_cloud_storage_note: Your key is stored only in the native app layer and is never written to browser storage or sent back to the UI after save.
privacy_cloud_testing_typed_key: Connection tests use the key currently typed in this form.
privacy_cloud_testing_saved_key: Connection tests use your saved native key when this field is empty.
privacy_cloud_testing_no_key: Paste a key or save one first before testing the cloud connection.
privacy_reset_description: Instantly wipe all cached metadata and search terms from the app.
privacy_reset_warning: Your actual files on your computer will remain completely untouched.
confirm_clear_index: Are you sure you want to clear your local search index? This only removes the app cache, your actual files will not be touched.
search_input_placeholder: Search files by name or content...
preview_empty_description: Click on a file item to view its details and content preview.
preview_not_available: No text content available for preview.
preview_still_analyzing_description: The file is available for browsing now, but text extraction or semantic ranking is still running in the background.
search_explanation_partial: This file is still being analyzed, so the explanation may be incomplete until semantic indexing finishes.
ocr_recommended_description: This file looks image-based or scanned. Enable OCR in a future pass to make its text searchable.
ocr_processing_description: This scanned file is being read in the background. Search quality will improve when OCR finishes.
ocr_failed_description: We could not read text from this scanned file yet. You can still open it normally while the index keeps working.
confidence_high_legend: Several strong ranking signals agree on this result, so it is very likely to fit the search well.
confidence_medium_legend: Multiple ranking signals support this result, but it is worth comparing with nearby matches.
confidence_low_legend: This file shares some signals with your query, but the match is less certain.
match_reason_exact_name_description: The search text matches the document name almost exactly.
match_reason_filename_match_description: Important query terms appear directly in the filename.
match_reason_semantic_description: The document meaning is close to your query even when the wording is different.
match_reason_project_context_description: The file sits in folders or project paths that overlap with your search.
match_reason_content_terms_description: Important query terms were found in the extracted document text.
match_reason_tag_match_description: Your saved tags line up with the query intent.
match_reason_starred_description: You starred this file earlier, so the rank treats it as higher importance.
match_reason_recent_update_description: The file was updated recently, which boosts likely active work.
match_reason_latest_signal_description: Version hints like final, approved, or higher revision numbers suggest a newer deliverable.
copy_path_modal_description: The path has been copied to your clipboard. You can paste it directly into your terminal or file explorer's address bar.
tour_scan_description: Start by scanning any folder on your computer. We'll extract metadata, content, and generate AI tags blazingly fast using your local hardware.
tour_search_description: Find files instantly by name or content. Our lightning-fast index retrieves results with zero cloud latency.
tour_settings_description: We respect your privacy. Everything stays on your machine. You can clear your index or export your cache directly from settings at any time.
tour_hotkey_description: Need a file urgently? Press the global hotkey (default: Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Space) from ANY application to open the quick search overlay.
starter_scan_description: Pick a few folders to scan first. We will make them searchable quickly, then continue deeper analysis in the background.
starter_scan_recommended_description: These are usually the best places to uncover work documents and active files fast.
starter_scan_background_note: Starter scan prioritizes metadata and quick retrieval first, then enriches content, OCR candidates, and semantic signals in the background.
starter_scan_folder_documents_descriptio: Drafts, contracts, reports, and the files you most likely search for at work.
starter_scan_folder_desktop_description: Recent files that still need organizing but matter in day-to-day work.
starter_scan_folder_downloads_descriptio: Incoming attachments, exported files, and new materials worth indexing early.
starter_scan_recommendations_failed: Couldn't load starter folders right now.
folder_intelligence_description: We surface the folders that currently look most active, important, or in need of attention.
workspace_drill_in_no_recent_changes: No recent changes are ready yet.
workspace_drill_in_ocr_summary: {count} scanned files still need usable text before they become fully searchable.
workspace_drill_in_summary_top_file: {name} is the best document to open first in {workspace}.
workspace_drill_in_summary_ocr: {count} scanned files still need OCR-ready text.
work_inbox_description: Open the app and see which document needs your attention now.
work_inbox_reason_continue_now: {name} was one of your recent document picks in {workspace}.
work_inbox_reason_needs_review: {name} changed since your last visit to {workspace}.
work_inbox_reason_open_now: {name} is the best document to open first in {workspace}.
work_inbox_reason_ocr_attention: {count} scanned files still need OCR-ready text in {workspace}.
work_inbox_evidence_changed_since_worksp: Changed since you last opened this workspace
work_inbox_evidence_changed_since_inbox: Changed after your last inbox visit
tree_view_empty_description: Try scanning or enabling a watched folder, or adjust your search and filters.
quick_look_preview_unavailable_descripti: We couldn't extract text content from this file.
